content.rendered:
?

Nehemiah 2:20 MSG

I shot back, “The God-of-Heaven will make sure we succeed. We’re his servants and we’re going to work, rebuilding. You can keep your nose out of it. You get no say in this – Jerusalem’s none of your business!”
?
Opposition to his dream was really huge, but, Nehemiah was not passive about it and neither was he silent.✔

?They were going to stop him with shots of discouragement, disillusionment, fear and many other weapons to weaken his hands and those working with him.

??The Bible said, he shot back.

?He shot back not with the same weapon or tactics of his adversary, but, with the word of God.✔
?
In today’s world, a lot of things and probably a lot of people are shooting at us with threats, fear, discouragement and sometimes, even with ungodly enticements.

?You can’t afford to keep quiet if you want to reach your goal.
?Nehemiah shot back and declared without any iota of doubt in him that the Almighty God would make sure he succeeded.
?
It’s time to “arm” yourself and shoot your shot.
?It’s time to contend with everything contending with you, threatening your destiny journey.
?You have all it takes to reach your goal.
?You have the Almighty God on your side and surely, you cannot lose.
?
As you shoot back today;
?The tide will turn in your favour.✔
The seemingly irreversible will be reversed.✔

You will press forward towards your goal.✔
?Your goal is none of their business…

You will reach your goal inspite of opposition in Jesus name??
